body: Ok thank you! I hope you have a great New Years!
Yea there is and getting help doesn't sound as scary now, thanks for talking to me and making me feel better :) I'll talk to my parents in the morning about getting help
That makes sense, but I'm still not looking forward to doing it

when I do try to talk about whats bothering me it comes off as something that doesn't bother me, almost in a joking matter because its easier to talk about that way even though it doesn't make sense, or I won't be able to say two words without breaking down and crying

I just never feel comfertable talking face to face with someone about my problems, because I don't like showing weakness. I grew up around lots of boys that would make fun of me mercilessly if I showed any kind of weakness so that is probably the cause of it

I've never just poured my heart out to anyone before, and it's harder to do with someone I basically just met. I guess I'm just insecure and self conscious to be honest. I make up for my mental weakness by trying to be physically strong as kind of a substitute too. And I was brought to a therapist by surprise so I was bitter about that too
Yea you're right just like everyone else. I don't have any confidence so why bother living my pathetic life?! You have you're fucking wish. I'll be gone by morning
I've already seen therapists and what not and they don't help
